|game_text=If [Virtual] Mind What You Have Learned on table, deploy on table with up to 6 Jedi Tests under here from outside your deck. You may not Force drain at Dagobah locations or deploy asteroid sectors, [Maintenance] cards, or [Permanent Weapon] cards. Whenever you draw training destiny, draw two and choose one. You may retrieve 3 Force whenever you complete a Jedi Test. Completed Jedi Tests are placed on table and are suspended (not lost) whenever character who completed them not on table.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Strong Is Vader]]. Other versions: [[Strong Is Vader]] (original) and [[Strong Is Vader (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, the current text). The revised Virtual Block 6.1 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image shown here print this text.
* '''Original''' ([[Strong Is Vader]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “If [Virtual] Mind What You Have Learned on table, deploy on table with up to 6 different Jedi Tests under here from outside your deck. You may not Force drain at Dagobah locations or deploy asteroid sectors, [Maintenance] cards, or [Permanent Weapon] cards. Whenever you draw training destiny, draw two and choose one. You may retrieve 3 Force whenever you complete a Jedi Test (cannot be canceled while you occupy a battleground). Completed Jedi Tests are placed on table and are suspended (not lost) whenever character who completed them not on table.”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the revised Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (PDF dated 20 April 2010) removed “different” and “(cannot be canceled while you occupy a battleground)”: “If [Virtual] Mind What You Have Learned on table, deploy on table with up to 6 Jedi Tests under here from outside your deck. You may not Force drain at Dagobah locations or deploy asteroid sectors, [Maintenance] cards, or [Permanent Weapon] cards. Whenever you draw training destiny, draw two and choose one. You may retrieve 3 Force whenever you complete a Jedi Test. Completed Jedi Tests are placed on table and are suspended (not lost) whenever character who completed them not on table.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1-revised">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet], revised copy (still headed "Official text as of September 4, 2009"; PDF dated 20 April 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee card image prints this text too. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 31) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Strong Is Vader (Errata 2)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Strong Is Vader (Errata 2)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 12 December 2012), in an entry labelled “Errata Text - September 9th, 2009”, changed “You Have Learned” to “You have Learned” and “choose one” to “chose one” (typos as published): “If [Virtual] Mind What You have Learned on table, deploy on table with up to 6 Jedi Tests under here from outside your deck. You may not Force drain at Dagobah locations or deploy asteroid sectors, [Maintenance] cards, or [Permanent Weapon] cards. Whenever you draw training destiny, draw two and chose one. You may retrieve 3 Force whenever you complete a Jedi Test. Completed Jedi Tests are placed on table and are suspended (not lost) whenever character who completed them not on table.”.<ref name="cl-1261_87-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive)</ref>
